# pai build

One machine-wide build queue: run, lock, queue, next, doctor, npm-auth, mirror-sync

```
pai build <command>
```

Heavy builds (xcodebuild, swift/gradle/cargo build or test) run machine-wide through builds.slots slots, simulator/device test runs through their own builds.testSlots slots, FIFO, at low priority, deltas by default. Raw builders are denied in Bash by the PreToolUse guard unless they go through `pai build run` or a door registered in the project's .pai/builds.yaml (`doors: [tools/build.sh]`, `patterns: [...]`). See docs/builds.md.

```sh
pai build run -- xcodebuild -scheme App build
pai build queue
```

### pai build run

Run a build command under the machine-wide build queue

```
pai build run [options]
```

Waits for a free build slot (builds.slots, default 1; FIFO across every session and worker on this computer), then runs the command at low CPU priority with its output logged. The whole process tree is killed when this command or its caller dies. The command gets PAI_BUILD_MODE=delta (default) or full (--full); project build scripts read it to build incrementally. The gate does not decide how to build deltas. Use --full only for a release or when asked. Jobs with the same --key (default: derived from a door script + its last argument, or xcodebuild -scheme) run one at a time so one target keeps one warm build tree; different keys overlap up to the slot limit. The command gets PAI_BUILD_JOBS (max(2, cores / slots)) to pass as -jobs. Simulator/device test runs use --kind test: their own pool (builds.testSlots, default 2), and the simulators the job booted are shut down when it ends.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--full` | flag | — | Full build (PAI_BUILD_MODE=full): releases only, or when asked |
| `--label TEXT` | string | — | Name shown in the queue (default: the command) |
| `--key NAME` | string | — | Build key (or PAI_BUILD_KEY): same-key jobs run one at a time, e.g. myapp-mac |
| `--kind build|test` | string | — | Slot pool: build (default) or test for simulator/device test runs |

```sh
pai build run -- xcodebuild -scheme App build
pai build run --kind test -- xcodebuild -scheme App test
pai build run --full --label release -- tools/build.sh
```

See also: `pai build queue`, `pai build lock`

### pai build lock

Same lock as `run`, for a project's door script to call

```
pai build lock [options]
```

A door script (registered in .pai/builds.yaml) wraps its real command in this: `pai build lock -- xcodebuild ...`. Same queue and lock as `pai build run`. Inside a `pai build run` it just runs the command, so doors can be nested without deadlock.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--full` | flag | — | Full build (PAI_BUILD_MODE=full): releases only, or when asked |
| `--label TEXT` | string | — | Name shown in the queue (default: the command) |
| `--key NAME` | string | — | Build key (or PAI_BUILD_KEY): same-key jobs run one at a time, e.g. myapp-mac |
| `--kind build|test` | string | — | Slot pool: build (default) or test for simulator/device test runs |

```sh
pai build lock -- xcodebuild -scheme App test
```

See also: `pai build run`, `pai build doctor`

### pai build queue

Show the running and waiting builds and tests

```
pai build queue
```

Lists, per pool (builds, tests), the jobs holding a slot and those waiting, in start order.

```sh
pai build queue
```

See also: `pai build next`

### pai build next

Give a waiting build the next free slot

```
pai build next ID
```

Moves one waiting build to the front of the queue; a running build is never interrupted.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Build id (or the label of a waiting build) |

```sh
pai build next b-20261019183000-4242
```

See also: `pai build queue`

### pai build doctor

Check the project's registered build doors and hook events

```
pai build doctor
```

Reads .pai/builds.yaml above the current directory and flags every door that is missing or never calls `pai build lock`, which would bypass the queue. Also prints one line per hook event: observed (a capture proves it ran), configured-but-never-observed (warning — the hook may silently not be running), or a configured hook whose script no longer exists (Stop: script missing — the hook never runs).

```sh
pai build doctor
```

### pai build npm-auth

Check the npm publish credential before `npm publish`

```
pai build npm-auth
```

Runs `npm whoami` against the public registry (10 s timeout). Exits 1 with the token renewal steps when npm rejects the credential; a timeout or network error is reported but does not fail. Used by prepublishOnly. A no-op when CI=true or GITHUB_ACTIONS=true (trusted publishing needs no token).

```sh
pai build npm-auth
```

See also: `pai build doctor`

### pai build mirror-sync

Trigger the forge's push mirror to GitHub and report each mirror

```
pai build mirror-sync [options]
```

For forge-first repos (origin = a Gitea/Forgejo forge, a push mirror to GitHub): POSTs push_mirrors-sync, then polls push_mirrors (60 s, every 3 s) until each mirror's last_update changes, and prints one line per mirror. A GitHub push-protection refusal (GH013) comes out as the short reason plus the unblock URL. Exits 0 when every mirror is ok. Token: the env var named by config release.forgeTokenEnv (default AIBROKER_FORGE_TOKEN); never printed.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--repo DIR` | string | — | Repo directory (default: this directory) |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print the parsed result as JSON |

```sh
pai build mirror-sync
pai build mirror-sync --repo ~/code/app --json
```

See also: `pai build npm-auth`

### pai build watch

Internal: kill a build tree when its gate process dies

```
pai build watch DIR ID
```

Started detached by `pai build run`.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DIR` | yes | Builds directory |
| `ID` | yes | Ticket id |

```sh
pai build watch DIR ID
```
